reasoning: 驗證已在 Service Mode 中時，$IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ 收到 8（駐車煞車已收回）TLM 顯示對應之 Brake Service popup。關鍵情境為單一回饋值之等價分割，且為 in-mode 狀態回報而非進出請求之回應。歸類依 R-VL22(c) 量測而定：規格段 1093–1095 及其鄰句掃 entering／exiting／request 命中 0（對照段 1066 有 entering、1099 有 exiting），故判 in-mode 型 —— 不設發起步，Service Mode 態置於 Pre-Condition（§4.4 之 feature initial state）。該值於 DBC 之 VAL_ 1486 無 label，依 §8.4.1 不造 label，寫 = 8 並於 remarks 揭露。

tcs.tc_title: EPB Maintenance feedback = 8: park brake retracted
pre_conditions: The EPB Maintenance Mode menu item is displayed
test_procedure: Read the named UI element "Brake Service - Park Brake Retracted" and check that it is displayed
expected_result: The signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ = 8 is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Brake Service - Park Brake Retracted" is displayed
tcs.test_item:
When the TLM receives the value 8 via signal, $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$, the TLM shall activate and display the popup: "Brake Service – Park Brake Retracted. To reset, press brake pedal and activate Park Brake switch."
(Fdbk = 8: park brake retracted reported while already in Service Mode)

distinguishing_axis.delta: Fdbk 值 8（駐車煞車已收回），in-mode 狀態回報型 —— 規格段 1093–1095 無 entering／exiting／request 詞，與進出側九條之發起型不同

tcs.remarks: DBC has no VAL_ entry for this raw value (VAL_ 1486 EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk defines 0 and 31 only), so no label is written. UI element names are taken from the popup wording named in the spec section and in the 037 description (R-VL21(a)). Grouping measured per R-VL22(c): spec paragraphs 1092-1096 contain none of entering, exiting or request, so this case is classified as an in-mode status report and carries no request step; the Service Mode state is held in the pre-conditions
